text: A grant unto Sir John Macneill, knight, of Dublin, and Thomas Barry, of Lyons, near Dublin, mechanic, for their invention of " Improvements in locomotive engines and in the construction of railways "; 6 months.
A grant unto William Huxiiam, of Exeter, in the coy of Devon, iron founder, for his invented " Certain improvements in the construction of I roofs " ; to hold, &c ; six months. By writ, &c.

A grant unto John Manton, of Dover Street, Piccadilly, in the county of Middlesex, gunraaker, for his invtd " Improvement in the construction of locks of all kinds of fowling pieces and fire arms "; to hold, &c ; two months. By writ, &c

A grant unto Edward Charles Howard, of Westbourn Green, in the county of Middx, esqr, for his invd certain improvements in the process of preparing and refining sugars ; to hold to him, his exors, admors, and assigns, within that part of our united kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland called England, our dominion of Wales, and town of Berwick-upon-Tweed, and also in all our colonies and plantations abroad, for the term of fourteen years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inroll the same within six calendar months from the date thereof. By writ, &c.

A grant unto Robert Hay ward, of Kelvedon Hall, in the county of Essex, of his new invented stirrup for saddles, on a new principle entirely, to prevent accidents of entangling the foot therein ; to hold to him, his exors, admors, & assigns, within England, Wales, & town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for the term of 14 years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inroll the same within four calendar months from the date hereof. W. H. M. at Westm1, the 2d day of June, in the year above. By writ, &c.

A grant unto Richard Hayton, of Gravel Lane, in the coy of Surrey, for his invented " Improved method of precipitating of copper from cupreous waters flowing from mines or from artificial waters, and of reducing some ores to their metallic state"; to hold, &c ; six months. By writ, &c.

A spiall priviledge granted to Edward Ball, esqre, & others, duringe the terme of 14 yeares next ensuing, of the sole practizing & putting in use of an invencon, by them found out, for the melting, makeing, fyneing, & burneing of iron, leade, tynne, salt, bricks, tyles, lyme, and other things for buildinge or otherwise to be made of earth (glasse only excepted), wth peate or turfe to be by them ppared for that purpose — rendring to His Matie the yearly rent of vju xiijs iiijd. Teste apud Canbury, 13 Augusti, anno pd. p bre &c.

A grant unto William Tickell, of the parish of Walcot, in the city of Bath, apothecary, of his new invented chemical medicine, which he calls spiritus aethercus anodynus, or anodyne aethereal spirit ; to hold to him, his executors, administrators, and assigns, within England, Wales, and town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for the term of fourteen years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inroll the same within one calendar month from the date hereof. Witness His Majesty at Westminster, the fifth day of August, in the year above. By writ, &c.
A grant unto Henry Gardener Gtiion Jude, of Lower Copenhagen Street, Barnsbury Road, Islington, for " Improvements in the manufacture of type "; 6 months ; a communication.

A grant unto Charles Cowper, of Southampton Buildings, Chancery Lane, in the county of Middlesex, patent agent, for " Improvements in 852. machinery for combing and preparing wool and other tibrous substances "; a communication : (J months ; colonies.

A grant unto Edwyn John Jeffery Dixon, of the Royal Slate Quarries, Bryntiafod, near Bangor, North Wales, for his invention of " Improvements in the manufacture of sinks and other articles of slate or stone"; (j months.

A grant unto Colonel William Congreve, of Cecil Street, in the county of Middx, for his invented and improved system of gun and carronade carriages ; to hold to him, his exors, admors, and assigns, within that part of our united kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland called England, our dominion of Wales, and town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for the term of fourteen years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inroll the same within two calendar months from the date thereof ; and also with a clause for supplying His Majesty's service with all such articles of the said invention as shall be required by the master general of the ordnance for the time being. By writ, &c.

A grant unto Henry Pratt, of Birmingham, in the county of Warwick, steel toy maker, for his invented new toast stand, or an improvem1 on the article called cats or dogs, upon wch things are placed before a fire ; to hold to him, his exors, admors, and assigns, within that part of our united kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland called England, our dominion of Wales, and town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for the term of fourteen years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inroll the same within one calendar month from the date thereof. By writ, &c.
A grant unto Abraham Garnett, of Demerara, esq., for his invented "Certain improvements in manufacturing sugar"; to hold, &c; six months. By writ, &c.

A grant unto Richard Wright, of Mount Row, Kent Road, in the county of Surrey, engineer, for his invented " Certain improvements in the process of distillation"; to hold, &c ; six months. By writ, &°.

A grant unto Joseph Ashton, of Birmingham, in the county of Warwick, of his new invented method of casting and making of coffin nails and jacks out of pig iron, commonly called cast metal, and of tinning the same ; to hold to him, his extors, admors, and assigns, within England, Wales, and town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for the term of 14 years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inroll the same within 4 calendar months from the date thereof. W. H. M. at W., the 7th day of Nov1, in the year above. By writt, &c.

A grant unto James Tulloch, of Savage Gardens, in the city of London, gentleman, for his invented and discovered "Improvement or improvements in the machinery to be employed for sawing and grooving marble and other stone, or in producing grooves or mouldings thereon"; to hold, &c; six months. By writ, &c.

A grant unto Samuel Newington, of Knole Frant, in the county of Sussex, doctor of medicine, for his invention of "Improvements in sowing, manuring, and cultivating land, and in certain of the implements used therein ; 6 months.

A grant unto Samuren Hunton Townsenp Bisnopr, of Hackney Terrace, in the county of Middlesex, gentleman, for his invention of “Improvements in the construction of the upper part of chimneys”; 6 months.

A grant unto Henry Gore Clough, of Norton Street, in the parish of Saint Mary-le-bone and county of Middlesex, surgeon, for his invented certain improvements in the instruments or apparatuses commonly called trusses, which arc used for compressing and supporting such parts of the human frame as are or may be ruptured or disposed to protrude ; to hold to him, his exors, admors, and assigns, within that part of our united kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland called England, our dominion of Wales, and town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for the term of fourteen years pursuant to the statute; with a clause to inroll the same within one calendar month from the date thereof. By writ, &c.

A grant unto Thomas Ryley and John Beaumont, of the city of London, brewers, their exors, admrs, and assigns, of the sole use and benefit, of their new invencon of a particular compound of wholesome ingredients of Gr divers and sundry sorts for the feeding of swine, and those fed in that manner will be never subject to the measles, and the said food is of so substantial a nature that it will make pork and bacon more solid and firm than any other pork and bacon fed in the accustomed way ; to hold and exercise the same within England, Wales, and town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for and during the term of 14 years according to the statute in such case made and pvided ; and a clause is inserted for obliging them to describe and ascertain the nature of their said invencon, by writing under their hands and seals, to be inrolled in the High Court of Chancery within one kalendar month from the date hereof. Teste ^ apd Westffi, 1° die Junij, anno pd. p bre, &c.
A grant unto Henry Newson, of Smethwick, near Birmingham, 1848. | for “ An improvement or improvements in trusses”; 6 months ; colonies.

A grant unto WM Radley, of the parish of Sl Andrew, Holborn, chymist, new invention, found out a new sort of purging and diuretic balls for the cure of several diseases incident to horses ; to hold to him, his executors, admors, and assigns, within England, Wales, & town of Berwickupon-Tweed, and also in the colonies and plantations abroad, for the term of fourteen years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inroll the same within four calendar months from the date thereof. W. H. M. at W., the 16th day of November, in the year above. By writ, &c.
A grant unto George Bennetts, of Gunnis Lake, in the county of Cornwall, civil engineer, for his invention of "Improvements in steam engines and boilers and in generating steam"; 6 months.

A grant unto John Sylvester, of Great Russell Street, in the county of Middlesex, engineer, for his invented " Certain improvements in apparatus for raising the temperature of air to warm and ventilate buildings ; to hold, &c ; two months. By writ, &c.

A grant unto John Wilkinson, of Broseley, in the county of Salop, ironmaster, of his new improvement in the method of making cannon or any other piece of ordnance made of metal, together with its shot, shell, or arrow, so contrived as to give a more certain direction to the mark intended than any other that has been hitherto in use ; to hold to him, his exors, admors, & asss, within Engd, Wales, & town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for ye term of 14 years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inrol the same within one calendar month from the date hereof. W. H. M. at Westr, the 30th day of July, in the year above. By writ, &c.

A grant unto Thomas Barnett, of the town of Kingston-upon- Hull, in the county of the same town, grocer, for his invention of " Improvements in machinery for grinding wheat and other grain"; 6 months ; colonies.
A grant unto Robert Allen Hurlock, of Whaddon, in the county of Cambridge, clerk, for his invention of "Improvements in axletrees"; 2 months.
A grant unto William Birkmyre, of Mill Brook, chemist, for his invention of " Certain improvements in the manufacture of potash and soda alums, sulphuric acid, and sulphate of soda"; 6 months.
A grant unto William Price Struve, of Swansea, civil engineer, for his invention of "Improvements in ventilating mines"; 6 months.

A grant unto John Maseres, of Rathbone Place, in the county of Middlesex, esq1-, of his new inventon apparatus, whereby any person, male or female, ma}r escape with the greatest ease & safety from a house or other building, & preserve his or her life, in case of accidents by fire ; to hold to him, his exors, admors, & asss, within England, Wales, & town of Berwick for the term of 14 years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inroll the same within four calendar months from the date hereof. W. H. M. at Westm1*, the 9th day of August, in the year above. By writ, &c.

A grant unto Witt1AM Buttock Tissirs, of Bramston, in the county of Northampton, gentleman, for his invention of “Improvements in obtaining, applying, and controlling motive power ; parts of which improyements are applicable to the raising and forcing of liquids”; 6 months. 12,804. A grant unto RicHarp ARCHIBALD Brooman, of 166, Fleet Street, 1848. | in the city of London, gentleman, for “Certain improvements in the manufacture of hinges and the machinery or apparatus used therein”; being a communication ; 6 months.

A grant unto John Lewis Ricaedo, of Lowndes Square, in the county of Middlesex, esquire, M.P., for his invention of " Improvements in electric telegraphs, and in apparatus connected therewith"; 6 months; colonies, except the provinces of Canada, Nova Scotia, and New Brunswick, and the Island of Prince Edward in North America.

A grant unto John Rowe, of Parransands, in the county of Cornwall, gent., of his new invencon of a mill for grinding of all sorts of mineral oars in a manner never heretofore practised ; to hold to him, his execrs, admls, & assigns, within England, Wales, & town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for the term of 14 years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inroll within 3 kalendar months from the date hereof. Witness His Matie at Westmr, the 27th day of May, in the year above. By writ, &c.
A grant unto JoeL Sritver, of Battersea, in the county of Surrey, engineer, for his invention of “ Improvements in cleaning and grinding wheat”; 6 months.

A grant unto Josue Heilmann, of Mullliausen, in the department du Haut Rhine, in France, machine maker, for his invention of " Improvements in certain machines used for preparing to be spun cotton, wool, and other fibrous materials "; 6 months.

A grant unto Robert Pretyman, of Ipswich, in the county of Suffolk, esq1-, for his invented improvement in the pan touch hole and pan cover of a gun lock ; to hold to him, his exors, admors, and assigns, within that part of our united kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland called England, our dominion of Wales, and town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for the term of fourteen years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inroll the same within six calendar months from the date thereof; and also with a clause for supplying His Majesty's service with all such articles of the said invention as shall be required by the master general of the ordnance for the time being. By writ, &c.

A grant unto Samuel Wilson Nickoll, of Elham, near Canterbury, in the county of Kent, gentleman, for his invention of ''Certain improve* ments in rendering condensing steam engines portable and applicable as a means of general transport on rail and other roads six months. By writ, &«,

A spiall priviledge graunted to Hugh Bullock and his assignes (for xiiij yeares nexte) to use & excise within England, Ireland, and Wales, and the plantations of Virginia and the Caribdia Islands, a certeine engine, by him invented, for the easie cuttinge of all sorts of tymber into planck and boord and other squares — paying therefore yearely into His Ma1'85 excheqr 40s duringe the said terme. Teste scdo Januarii. I? bre &c.

A grant unto Thomas Pease, of the parish of Sl Martin-in-the-Fields, in the county of Middx, coach spring maker, & William Monk, of the parish of Sl Margaret Westm1", in the said county, coachmaker & wheelwright, of their new invented axeltrees, whereby vehicles & carriages will be rendered more comodious & better for travelling, with less labour, agitation, & noise, than by any invencon hitherto found out ; to hold to them, their execrs, admrs, & assigns, within England, Wales, & town of Berwick-upon- Tweed, and His Matie's colonies & plantacons abroad, for the term of 14 years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inroll the same within four kalendar months from the date hereof. Witness His Matie at Westmr, the 29th day of November, in the year above. By writ, &c.
A grant unto Charles Phillips, of Chipping Norton, in the county of Oxford, engineer, for his invention of " Improvements in reaping and cutting vegetable substances as food for cattle"; six months.

A grant unto George Fergusson Wilson, of Belmont, Vauxhall, in the county of Surrey, gent11, George Gwynne, of Princes Street, Cavendish Square, in the county of Middlesex, gent", and James Pillans Wilson, of Belmont aforesaid, gent11, for their invention of " Improvements in treating fatty and oily matters, and in the manufacture of candles"; 6 months.

A grant unto John Read, of Tipton, in the county of Stafford, gentleman, and William Howell, of Wednesbury, in the same coy, ground bailiff, for their invtd " New system of working and getting the main or thick mine of coals"; to hold, &( ; two months. By writ, &c.
A grant unto James Morris, of Cateaton Street, in the city of London, merchant, for "Improvements in locomotive and other steam engines"; 6 months.

A grant unto John Ryan, of Liverpool Street, in the city of London, surgeon, for his invention of " Certain improvements applicable to or in the construction of casks, barrels, or other vessels intended to contain wine, beer, fermented liquors, or other liquids or substances which are liable to fermentation or decomposition from exposure to the action of the atmosphere "; 6 months.

A grant unto Andrew Ure, of Southampton How, in the county of Middlesex, doctor of medicine, for his invented "An air stove apparatus for the exhalation and condensation of vapours"; to hold, &c: six months. By writ. fc*.

A grant unto John Higgins, of Fulhain, in the coy of Middx, esq., for his invented " Certain improvements upon the construction of carriages, which he conceives will be of great public utility "; six mos. By writ, &c.

A grant unto Nathan Defries, of Grafton Street, Fitzroy Square, civil engineer, and George Brooks Pettit, of Brook Street, New Road, in the county of Middlesex, gas fitter, for their invention of " Improvements in applying gas to heat apparatus containing fluids, and in heating and ventilating buildings ; also improvements in gas fittings and apparatus for controlling the passage of gas"; 6 months.

A grant unto Alfred Elam, of Huddersfield, in the county of York, surgical instrument maker, for his invention of " Improvements in apparatus or instruments for the relief and cure of procedencia and prolapsus uteri"; 6 months.

A grant unto John Edwards, of Vine Street, Lambeth, in the county of Surry, engineer, for his new invented improvements in distilling, rectifying, and dying, whereby the same wTill be considerably accelerated and the consumption of fuel will be materially reduced ; to hold to him, his exors, admors, and assigns, within England, Wales, and the town of Berwick-upon- Tweed for the term of fourteen years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inroll the same within six calendar months from the date thereof. W. H. M. at Westm1', the 3d day of Aug1, in the year above. By writ, &c.

A grant unto John Leach, of Merton Abbey, in the county of Surry, calico printer, for his new invented improvements on steam engine boilers; to hold to him, his exors, admors, and assigns, within England, Wales, and the town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for the term of fourteen years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inroll the same within six calendar months from the date thereof. W. H. M. at Westmr, the 7th day of April, in the year above. By writ, &c.

A grant unto John Dickinson, of Nash Mill, in the parish of Abbotts Langley, in the county of Herts, esq., for his invented or found out " An improved method of manufacturing paper by means of machinery"; to hold, &c ; six months. By writ, &c.

His Matie haveing been informed by Francis Lord Willoughby & Lawrence Hyde, esqr, that one Davie de Meurato hath found a new way of makeing & frameing of sugar mills, is graciously pleased, att the desire of the said David Meurato, to graunt the sole exercise and benefitt thereof unto the said Francis Lord Willoughby and Lawrence Hyde, and their assignes, for the terme of 21 yeares ; with such provisoes, powers, & clauses as are usuall in graunts of fike nature. Teste ^ apud Westm1, 4° Febr, 16 Car 2di. By the King.

A grant unto Frederick William Etheredge, of Frindsbury, in the county of Kent, gentleman, for his invention of " Certain improvements in the manufacture of bricks, tiles, and other similar plastic substances "; 6 months.

A grant unto Wilton George Turner, of Park Village, Regent's Park, doctor in philosophy, and Herbert Minton, of Longfield Cottage, in the parish of Stoke-upon-Trent, in the county of Stafford, manufacturer, for " An improved porcelain"; 6 months.

A grant unto Robert Winch, of Stewards Buildings, Battersea Fields, in the county of Surrey, engineer, for his invented " Certain improvements in or additions to rotatory pumps for raising and forcing water or other liquids "; to hold, &c ; six months. By writ, &c.

A grant unto Robert Mason, of Chipping Sodbury, in the county of Gloucester, surgeon and apothecary, of his new invented medicine for the effectual extirpation of worms and their cause from the human body in persons of all ages, as also for the relief and cure of divers other complaints and diseases ; to hold to him, his exors, admors, & asss, within England, Wales, & town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for the term of 14 years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inrol the same within one calendar month from the date hereof. W. H. M. at Westr, the 15th day of May, in the year above. By writ, &c.
A grant unto Roperr Apams, of King William Street, in the city London, gun maker, for “ Improvements in rifles and other fire-arms”; being partly a communication ; 6 months.
A grant unto Jaques Francois Pinel, of Lyons, in the kingdom of France, chemist, for his invention of " Improvements in grinding wheat and other grain"; 6 months ; colonies.
A grant unto Joseph Warren, of Heybridge, in the county of Essex, agricultural implement maker, for his invention of " Certain improvements in ploughs "; 6 months.

His Matie is hereby pleased to grant unto George Oldner, sen1", and Andrew Prune a speciall lycence for the exercise of a new invencon, by them found out, for the better pserving all sorts of shipps or vessells for navigacon, already built or hereafter to be built, from foundring, either at sea or in any harbour, bayes, rivers, or creekes, by reason of any leakes from great shot, or by waineholmes, or by want of good cawking, or by decay of cawking, &c. ; to hold to them, their exors, adffiors, & assigns, for the terme of fourteene yeares according the statute in that case provided ; with the vsuall clauses. Testib Thoma, &c., 24° die Septem1, anno supdco.
A grant unto James Insole, of Birmingham, saddlers ironmonger, for his invention of " Improvements in the manufacture of brushes 6 months.

A grant unto Joseph Collet, of the city of London, practitioner in physick, of his new invented medicine, called oleum vitas, or the ladies' nervous & cordial drops ; to hold to him, his execrs, admrs, & assigns, within England, Wales, & town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for the term of 14 years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inroll within 3 kalendar months from the date hereof. Witness His Matie at Westmr, the 2nd day of Dec1, in the year above. By writ, &c.

A grant unto James Gregory, coal master, and William Green, tinner, both of West Bromwich, in the county of Stafford, for their invention of " Certain improvements in the manufacture of iron and steel " ; six months.

A grant unto ALFRED VINCENT NEwron, of the Office for Patents, Chancery Lane, in the county of Middlesex, mechanical draughtsman, for ‘“‘ Certain improvements in the manufacture of sugar ;” being a communication ; 6 months. :

A grant unto William Bache, of Birmingham, in the co. of Warwick, chymist, of his new invented instrument or machine which he calls by the name of a propeller, to be applied for the improving the power of mills and forges, and to answer various other hydrostatical purposes ; to hold to him, his exors, adfhors, & asss, within England, Wales, and Berwickupon-TAveed for the term of 14 years psuant to the statute ; with a clause to inroll the same within 4 calendar months from the date hereof. W. H. M. at Westm1, the 4th day of May, in the year above. By writ, &c.
A grant unto John Ericsson, of Brook Street, New Road, in the county of Middlesex, civil engineer, for his invention of " An improved propeller, applicable to steam navigation"; 6 months.

A grant unto Abraham Henry Chambers, of New Bond Street, in the county of Middlesex, esq., for his invented " Improvement in preparing and paving horse and carriage Avays"; to hold, &c ; six months. By writ, &c.
A grant unto John Stephens, of ICennington, in the county of Surrey, esquire, for his invention of " Improvements in obtaining and applying motive power "; 6 months ; colonies.

A grant unto Ropert Srreet, of Providence Row, in the parish of Christ Church, Surry, varnish maker, of his new invented method to produce an inflammable vapour-force by means of liquid, air, fire, and flame, for communicating motion to engines, pumps, and machinery ; to hold to him, his eXors, adfiors, & ass’, within England, Wales, & town of Berwick-upon- Tweed for the term of 14 y® pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inrol the same within one calendar month from the date hereof. W.H.M. at West", the 7‘ day of May, in the year above. By writ, &.

A grant unto John Wormald, of Manchester, in the county of Lancaster, maker-up and packer, for his invention of " Improvements in machinery or apparatus for spinning and doubling cotton, wool, silk, Max, or other fibrous substances"; G months ; colonies. 5 0 2
A grant unto William Ciiesterman, of Burford, in the county of Oxford, engineer, for his invention of " Improvements in stoves"; 6 months.

A grant unto Marc Isambard Brunel, of Chelsea, in the county of Middx, civil engineer, for his invented certain improvements in saw mills ; to hold to him, his exors, admors, and assigns, within that part of our united kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland called England, our dominion of Wales, and town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for the term of fourteen years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inroll the same within two calendar months from the date thereof. By writ, &c.

A grant unto William Edward Newton, of Chancery Lane, in the county of Middlesex, civil engineer, for "Improvements in machinery for hulling and polishing rice and other grain or seeds"; being a communication; 6 months ; colonies.

A grant unto Oglethorpe Wakelin Barratt. of Birmingham, in the county of Warwick, metal gilder, for " Certain improvements in the process of decomposing muriate of soda for the manufacture of mineral alkali and other valuable products"; 6 months.

A grant unto Thomas Merricks, of Uckfield, in the county of Sussex, smith, of his new invented improvements in the construction of ploughs, by which means the ground may be ploughed at a much less expence than can at present be effected; to hold to him, his exors, admors, & asss, within Engd, Wales, & town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for the term of 14 yrs pursuant to the statute; with a clause to inrol the same within one calendar month from the date hereof. W. H. M. at Westr, the 16th day of August, in the year of our Lord 1791. By writ, &c.

A grant unto Durs Egg, of the Strand, in the county of Middx, gun maker, for his invented certain improvements in the construction of fire arms and their locks, and also in the apparatus for trying and loading them ; to hold to him, his exors, admors, and assigns, within that part of our united kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland called England, our dominion of AVales, and town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for the term of fourteen years pursuant to the statute ; with clause to inroll the same within two calendar months from S S 2 the date thereof; and also with a clause for supplying the elder brethren of the Trinity House and master general of the ordnance for the time being. By writ, &c.

A grant unto Wastel Cliffe, of West Bromwich, in the county of 793. Stafford, esq1-, of his invented method of making plane irons, and making, and fastening to proper handles, hoes and all sorts of trowels from rolled steel ; to hold to him, his exors, admors, & asss, within Engd, Wales, & town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for the term of 14 yrs pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inrol the same within one calendar month from the date hereof. W. H. M. at West1, the 9th day of December, in the year above. By writ, &c.

A grant unto James Johnson, of Waterloo Place, Haggerstone Bridge, Kingsland, in the county of Middlesex, hat manufacturer, for his invention of "Certain improvements in the manufacture of hats"; 6 months ; colonies.

A grant unto Elisha Peck, of Liverpool, in the county of Lancaster, merchant, that in consequence of a communication made to him by Ralph Buckley, a foreigner resident in the city of New York and a citizen of the United States of America, he is in possession of " An invention of a certain machinery, to be worked by water, applicable to the moving of mills and other machinery of various descriptions, or for forcing or pumping water six months. By writ, &c.

A grant unto Roperr Jupe, of New Bond Street, in the parish of Saint George, Hanover Square, in the county of Middlesex, upholsterer, for his invention of “ An improved expanding table” ; six months. By writ, &«.

A grant unto Alexander Dean and Evan Evans, of Birmingham, in the county of Warwick, millwrights, for their invention of " Certain improvements in mills for reducing grain and other substances to a pulverised state, and in the apparatus for dressing or bolting pulverised substances "; 6 months.

A grant unto Joun Ericsson, of Liverpool, in the county palatine of Lancaster, civil engineer, for his invented or found out “An improved engine for communicating power for mechanical purposes”; to hold, & ; six months. By writ, &«.

A grant unto William Gossage, of Stoke Prior, in the county of Worcester, chemist, for his invention of "Certain improved apparatus for decomposing common salt, and for condensing and making use of the gaseous product of such decomposition; also certain improvements in the mode of the conducting these processes"; 6 months.

A grant unto Louis John Pouchee, of King Street, Covent Garden, in the county of Middlesex, type founder, in consequence of a communication made to him by a certain foreigner residing abroad he is in possession of " Certain machinery or apparatus to be employed in the casting of metal types"; to hold, &c ; six months. By writ, &c.

A grant unto Melvil Wilson, of Warnford Court, Throgmorton Street, in the city of London, merchant, in consequence of a communication made to him by a certain foreigner residing abroad he is in possession of an invention of " Certain impr" in machinery for cleaning rice "; to hold, &r: six months. By writ, 8c'".

A grant unto James Smethurst, of New Bond Street, in the county of Middx, lamp manufacturer, for his invented certain improvem,s applicable to lamps of different descriptions ; to hold to him, his exors, admors, and assigns, within that part of our united kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland called England, our dominion of Wales, and town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for the term of fourteen years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inroll the same within six calendar months from the date thereof. By writ, &c.

A grant unto John Bigg, of Iping, in the county of Sussex, paper maker, of his new invented mode of bleaching paper by a cheap and expeditious process, in consequence of which the colour of such paper will be so effectually fixed as not to be affected by heat or any length of time ; to hold to him, his exors, admors, & ass3, within Engd, Wales, & town of Berwick-upon-Tweed for the term of 14 years pursuant to the statute ; with a clause to inrol the same within one calendar month from the date hereof.
